Rename within a file: a local, a private function (the call_out string
is no call of it in DGD, and is left, with a message), a private
variable, a macro the file defines. prepareRename says what is renamed
there, or why not; a rename that must not be made is an error with the
reason.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
#define BASE "/std/base"
-- lib/std/base.c --
int weight;
-- lib/obj/a.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit BASE;

#define LIMIT 3

private int count;

private void tick() {
    int n;
    for (n = 0; n < LIMIT; n++) {
        count += n;
    }
}

static void start() {
    tick();
    call_out("tick", 1);
}
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
received window/logMessage

prepare lib/obj/a.c 16:15
prepare lib/obj/a.c 14:13

rename lib/obj/a.c 9:9 i
rename lib/obj/a.c 7:14 step

rename lib/obj/a.c 9:9 2x
rename lib/obj/a.c 9:9 weight
shutdown
exit
